主要内容: On March 14, 2016, Optical Cable Corporation issued a press release announcing its first quarter of fiscal year 2016 financial results. The company also held an earnings call on the same date. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1, and the transcript of the earnings call is attached as Exhibit 99.2. The report was signed by Tracy G. Smith, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, on March 15, 2016. The filing is part of the company's compliance with the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. No specific financial figures or operational details were disclosed in the text provided, but the event marks the release of the company's quarterly financial results and the subsequent earnings call discussion.
